## **3\. Issues/Suggestions**

* **Issue 1 (AI hallucination):** Generic LLMs invent historical facts and confuse timelines.  
  *Solution:* Two-stage retrieval (vector search + re-ranking) so that answers are grounded only in curated documents (see BR-14, BR-15).  
* **Issue 2 (Username collision across schools):** Imported student/teacher codes may repeat between schools.  
  *Solution:* System-generated usernames prefixed with the school code (BR-08).  
* **Issue 3 (AI response latency):** Waiting for a full answer causes drop-off.  
  *Solution:* Responses are streamed token by token; first content must appear within 1.5 s (PER-01).  
* **Issue 4 (Open requirement items):** Tier prices, token conversion rate and school quota defaults in BR-03 – BR-07 must be confirmed with the supervisor before Review 2.

# **II. Software Requirement Specification**

## **1\. Overall Description**

### **1.1 Product Overview**

HistoryTalk is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform for Vietnamese history education. It replaces passive memorization with interactive learning: learners talk with AI-simulated historical figures whose answers are grounded in curated sources, explore events on a time-based map, and check their knowledge with quizzes.

The platform serves two business models:

1. **B2C (individual learners):** Customers register for free and may upgrade to the Plus or Pro package to get a larger daily AI token allowance.  
2. **B2B (secondary and high schools):** Each school is an isolated tenant. School Admins onboard teachers and students and allocate AI token quota; Teachers create local historical content (approved by the School Admin) and assign multi-part homework (Read Context → Chat with Character → Take Quiz) to their classes, then monitor results.

**Context Diagram**

![context diagram][image2]

| External Entity | Interaction with HistoryTalk |
| :---- | :---- |
| PayOS Gateway | Receives payment orders, displays VietQR, sends signed payment webhooks; answers order status queries. |
| AI / LLM Engine | Receives grounded prompts, returns streamed answers and token usage; produces embeddings for document chunks. |
| Google OAuth | Verifies Google identity tokens for Customer sign-in. |
| Email Service | Delivers password-reset links and payment receipts. |
| Cloud Storage | Stores avatars, audio, uploaded PDF/scanned documents. |

**Scope**

* **In scope (Release 1.0):** web application for all six user roles; AI character chat; historical map; quizzes; school assignments; B2C payment via PayOS; content curation with OCR.

* **Out of scope:** native mobile application; payment by card or e-wallet other than VietQR; B2B invoicing (school contracts are billed offline); teacher-to-student messaging; content in languages other than Vietnamese.

**Assumptions & Dependencies**

* The AI Engine, PayOS and Google OAuth are available as third-party services; their outages degrade the related functions only (see REL-04).  
* AI performance targets (PER-01) assume the external LLM provider meets its own published latency.  
* Each school provides a unique school code and student/teacher codes in its Excel roster.

**Constraints**

Vietnamese is the only UI language; all personal data is stored in Vietnam-compliant cloud regions; students are mostly minors, so personal data handling must follow Vietnam's personal data protection regulations (SEC-07).

**Definitions & Acronyms**

| Term | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tenant | A school registered on the platform; its data is isolated from other schools. |
| Learner | A Customer or a School Student (anyone who studies on the platform). |
| Historical Context | A historical period or event (e.g., "Điện Biên Phủ Campaign 1954") used to group characters, documents, quizzes and map events. |
| Global content | Content curated by Content Admins, visible to all users. |
| Local content | Content created by a Teacher, visible only inside that teacher's school after approval. |
| Token | The platform unit that measures AI chat usage (see BR-03). |
| RAG | Retrieval-Augmented Generation: answering by first retrieving relevant curated document chunks. |
| TTFT | Time To First Token: time from sending a question until the first part of the answer is displayed. |
| OCR | Optical Character Recognition: extracting text from scanned documents. |
| SSE | Server-Sent Events: the protocol used to stream AI answers to the browser. |

### **1.2 Business Rules**

The detailed, numbered rules are in section 5.1. The key groups are:

* **Tenant & accounts:** school data is visible only to that school; usernames, passwords, login and sessions (BR-01, BR-02, BR-08 – BR-10, BR-29 – BR-31, BR-33 – BR-35).  
* **Token economy:** each AI chat turn consumes tokens; quotas reset daily; schools draw from a contract pool (BR-03 – BR-07).  
* **Content:** global and local content lifecycles and approval; file limits (BR-11 – BR-13, BR-32, BR-36, BR-37).  
* **AI grounding & persona:** answers come only from curated sources and keep historically correct forms of address (BR-14 – BR-16).  
* **Assessment & assignments:** quiz scoring, timing, attempts, deadlines and late submission (BR-17 – BR-23).  
* **Payment:** order lifecycle, webhook verification and subscription rules (BR-24 – BR-28).

## **2\. User Requirements**

### **2.1 System Actors**

| \# | Actor | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Customer | Individual (B2C) learner. Registers by email or Google, uses Free/Plus/Pro packages, chats with characters, explores the map, takes practice quizzes. |
| 2 | School Student | Learner belonging to a school tenant. Logs in with school-issued credentials, does assigned homework, chats with characters, takes quizzes. Cannot purchase packages. |
| 3 | Teacher | Instructor in a school. Creates local content and assignments for the classes he/she is assigned to, and monitors class results. |
| 4 | School Admin | Administrator of one school. Imports accounts, manages classes and members, approves local content, allocates token quota. |
| 5 | Content Admin | Platform history specialist. Curates global contexts, characters, reference documents, quizzes and map events. |
| 6 | System Admin | Platform super-administrator. Provisions school tenants, manages accounts and subscription tiers, monitors platform health and revenue. |
| 7 | PayOS Gateway | External payment system that processes VietQR transfers and sends payment confirmations. |
| 8 | AI / LLM Engine | External/AI service that generates grounded answers and document embeddings. |
| 9 | Google OAuth | External identity provider used for Customer sign-in. |
| 10 | Email Service | External service that sends system emails. |

"Learner" is used in diagrams as a generalization of Customer and School Student.

#### **3.1.4 Non-Screen Functions**

| \# | Feature | System Function | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | AI Chat | AI Answer Streaming & Token Deduction | Builds the grounded prompt, streams the answer to the browser, saves the message and deducts tokens (see 3.4.3). |
| 2 | Token | Daily Token Reset Job | Runs daily at 00:00 (UTC+7); restores daily balances of all learners (see 3.12.1). |
| 3 | Payment | Payment Webhook Handler | Receives PayOS callbacks, verifies signature, completes orders idempotently (see 3.7.2). |
| 4 | Payment | Payment Reconciliation Job | Every 5 minutes; queries PayOS for orders still PENDING and expires unpaid orders (see 3.7.3). |
| 5 | Payment | Subscription Expiry Job | Daily at 00:05 (UTC+7); downgrades expired subscriptions to Free (see 3.12.2). |
| 6 | Content | Document Processing Worker | Extracts text (OCR for scans), splits into chunks and requests embeddings (see 3.10.3). |
| 7 | Assignment | Assignment Deadline Job | Every minute; marks unsubmitted work OVERDUE and closes assignments (see 3.8.5). |
| 8 | Notification | Notification Dispatcher | Creates in-app notifications (new assignment, deadline in 24 h, content approved/rejected, payment result). |
| 9 | Content | Trash Purge Job | Daily at 02:00 (UTC+7); permanently deletes items trashed more than 30 days ago (COM-05). |
| 10 | Security | Session Cleanup Job | Hourly; removes expired revoked-session entries. |

#### **3.1.5 Entity Relationship Diagram**

The ERD is shown in three parts for readability. Attribute-level design (data types, keys, indexes) is defined in Report 4 – Software Design Description.

**Part 1 – Users, schools, subscriptions**

![][erd1]

**Part 2 – Learning content, chat, quiz**

![][erd2]

**Part 3 – Assignments**

![][erd3]

**Entities Description**

| \# | Entity | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | User | Any account of the six roles; holds credentials, role, status (ACTIVE/LOCKED), daily token balance and school (for school roles). |
| 2 | School | A tenant: school code, name, contract start/end, token pool size and remaining balance, per-student default daily limit. |
| 3 | Classroom | A class of a school (e.g., 12A1), school year, status. |
| 4 | Class Student | Enrollment of a student in a class. |
| 5 | Class Teacher | Assignment of a teacher to a class. |
| 6 | Subscription Tier | A B2C package: name, price, duration in days, daily token allowance, active flag. |
| 7 | User Subscription | A Customer's package period: tier, start date, end date, status (ACTIVE/EXPIRED). |
| 8 | Payment Order | A purchase: order code, amount, tier, status (BR-24), PayOS reference, timestamps. |
| 9 | Token Transaction | Ledger of every token change: reset, deduction per chat turn, refund, quota adjustment. |
| 10 | Historical Context | A historical period/event; global or local (owned by a school); status (BR-11). |
| 11 | Character | Historical figure: biography, avatar, era, persona instructions, form of address. |
| 12 | Document | Uploaded reference source linked to a context and/or character; processing status. |
| 13 | Document Chunk | A passage of a document with its embedding, used for AI grounding. |
| 14 | Map Event | Location (coordinates), start/end year, title and linked context. |
| 15 | Chat Session | A conversation between a learner and a character. |
| 16 | Chat Message | One question or answer with tokens used and cited chunks. |
| 17 | Quiz | A set of questions with time limit, pass score, attempt limit, shuffle and show-answer settings. |
| 18 | Question | Single-choice, multiple-choice or fill-in question with explanation and difficulty. |
| 19 | Answer Option | A choice of a question with a correctness flag, or an accepted answer for fill-in questions. |
| 20 | Quiz Attempt | One attempt: start/end time, score, status (IN_PROGRESS/SUBMITTED/AUTO_SUBMITTED). |
| 21 | Attempt Answer | The answer given to one question in an attempt. |
| 22 | Assignment | Homework for one or more classes: title, deadline, late policy, status (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CLOSED). |
| 23 | Assignment Task | One task of an assignment: READ_CONTEXT, CHAT_CHARACTER (minimum turns) or TAKE_QUIZ. |
| 24 | Assignment Submission | A student's overall status for an assignment (BR-21) and final score. |
| 25 | Task Progress | A student's progress on one task, linked to the chat session or quiz attempt used. |
| 26 | Content Review | Review history of local content: submitter, reviewer, decision, reason, time. |
| 27 | Notification | In-app message to a user: type, content, read flag. |
| 28 | Audit Log | Record of sensitive actions (login, lock/unlock, approval, import, payment status change). |


### **3.2 Authentication & Account**

#### **3.2.1 Log In**

* **Function trigger:** User opens S-02 Login from the Landing page or any protected URL while not signed in; clicks "Đăng nhập" or "Tiếp tục với Google".  
* **Function description:** All roles authenticate with username/email and password; Customers may also use Google. After success the system issues a session and redirects by role: Customer/Student → S-07, Teacher → S-25, School Admin → S-32, Content Admin → S-40, System Admin → S-47. (UC-01)  
* **Screen layout:**

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|                 HistoryTalk – Chắp cánh tri thức lịch sử     |
|                     [ ĐĂNG NHẬP HỆ THỐNG ]                   |
|  Email hoặc Tên đăng nhập: [_______________________________] |
|  Mật khẩu:                 [_______________________] (👁)    |
|  [ ] Ghi nhớ đăng nhập                    Quên mật khẩu?     |
|  [                    ĐĂNG NHẬP                        ]     |
|  ------------------------- HOẶC ----------------------       |
|  [ (G) Tiếp tục với tài khoản Google                   ]     |
|  Chưa có tài khoản? [Đăng ký ngay]                           |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

* **Function details:**  
  * *Data:* identifier (username or email, max 100 chars), password, remember-me flag.  
  * *Validation:* both fields required (MSG02).  
  * *Business rules:* BR-29 – BR-31, BR-34, BR-35.  
  * *Normal flow:* 1) User enters credentials. 2) System verifies password and account status. 3) System creates the session (BR-34) and records an audit entry. 4) If the account must change password (BR-08), the user is sent to S-05 with MSG22; otherwise to the role home screen.  
  * *Google flow:* 1) User selects a Google account. 2) System verifies the Google token. 3a) Email belongs to a Customer → sign in. 3b) Email is new → create a Customer account with the Free tier and sign in. 3c) Email belongs to a school/admin account → reject with MSG25.  
  * *Abnormal:* wrong identifier or password → MSG09 (the message does not reveal which one is wrong); 5th consecutive failure → MSG16 and the account is blocked for 15 minutes; account LOCKED by an admin → MSG15; school contract expired → MSG24; Google/identity service unavailable → MSG14.

#### **3.2.2 Register Account**

* **Function trigger:** Visitor clicks "Đăng ký ngay" (S-01, S-02) and opens S-03.  
* **Function description:** Creates a Customer account with the Free tier and full daily allowance. (UC-02)  
* **Screen layout:** S-03 contains: Display name, Email, Password, Confirm password, checkbox "Tôi đồng ý với Điều khoản sử dụng và Chính sách quyền riêng tư", button "Đăng ký", link "Đã có tài khoản? Đăng nhập".  
* **Function details:**  
  * *Validation:* all fields required (MSG02); display name 2–50 characters (MSG08); valid email format (MSG17); password follows BR-29 (MSG18); confirm password matches (MSG19); terms must be accepted.  
  * *Normal flow:* system creates the account (role CUSTOMER, tier FREE, balance per BR-04), signs the user in and opens S-07 with MSG04.  
  * *Abnormal:* email already registered (including via Google) → MSG20.

#### **3.2.3 Reset Password**

* **Function trigger:** User clicks "Quên mật khẩu?" on S-02 and opens S-04.  
* **Function description:** Sends a one-time reset link to the account's email; the user sets a new password from that link. (UC-03)  
* **Screen layout:** Step 1: email field + "Gửi liên kết". Step 2 (from email link): New password, Confirm password, "Đặt lại mật khẩu".  
* **Function details:**  
  * *Rules:* BR-29, BR-33. School students without an email cannot use this function; their password is reset by the School Admin (3.9.3).  
  * *Normal flow:* system always shows MSG05 (whether or not the email exists, to prevent account discovery); if the email exists, the Email Service sends the link. After the new password is saved, all existing sessions are revoked and MSG03 is shown on S-02.  
  * *Abnormal:* link expired or already used → MSG21; password rules → MSG18/MSG19.

* **Function trigger:** User opens S-05 from S-06, or is redirected there at first login.  
* **Function description:** Changes the password of the signed-in user. (UC-04)

* **Function details:** current password must be correct (MSG09); new password follows BR-29 and must differ from the current one (MSG18); confirmation must match (MSG19). On success, other sessions are revoked, the "must change password" flag is cleared and MSG03 is shown.

### **3.4 AI Character Chat**

#### **3.4.1 Chat with Historical Character**

* **Function trigger:** Learner clicks "Trò chuyện" on S-11, S-15 or S-20, or resumes a session from S-14; then sends a question.  
* **Function description:** Learner talks with a historical figure who answers in the first person, based only on curated documents; the answer is streamed. (UC-09)  
* **Screen layout:**

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [<- Quay lại]   ĐẠI TƯỚNG VÕ NGUYÊN GIÁP              Còn lại: 1.420 token |

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| (AI) Chào cháu. Ta là Võ Nguyên Giáp... Cháu muốn hỏi ta điều gì?       |
|                          (Bạn) Vì sao Đại tướng đổi phương châm tác chiến?|
| (AI) [đang trả lời...] Quyết định chuyển từ "đánh nhanh thắng nhanh"    |
|      sang "đánh chắc tiến chắc" là ...                                   |
|      Nguồn: [1] Điện Biên Phủ – Điểm hẹn lịch sử, tr.112                 |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Gợi ý: [ Kéo pháo vào Điện Biên? ] [ Vai trò của dân công? ]            |
| [ Nhập câu hỏi (tối đa 500 ký tự)...                     ] [GỬI] [■ Dừng]|
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

* **Function details:**  
  * *Validation:* question 1–500 characters (MSG02, MSG08); only one answer in progress per session.  
  * *Business rules:* BR-03 – BR-06, BR-14 – BR-16.  
  * *Normal flow:* 1) System checks the balance (BR-05) and, for students, the school pool (BR-06). 2) Question is saved and sent to the AI Engine (3.4.3). 3) Answer is displayed progressively, followed by source references and up to 3 suggested follow-up questions. 4) Balance shown on screen is updated.  
  * *Abnormal:* balance below the minimum → input disabled and S-13 shown with MSG10; school pool exhausted → MSG23; no answer within 30 s or AI Engine error → MSG14, the question is kept and no tokens are deducted; user clicks "Dừng" → partial answer kept and charged for generated part (BR-05).  
  * *Out-of-scope or unsafe question:* the character politely declines in persona (BR-15).

#### **3.4.3 AI Answer Streaming & Token Deduction (non-screen)**

* **Function trigger:** Each question sent from S-12.  
* **Function description:** Produces a grounded answer and charges tokens.  
* **Screen layout:** N/A – non-screen function (runs in the background, no user interface).
* **Function details:**  
  1. Retrieves the passages most relevant to the question from the documents of the character and its context (global, or local of the same school).  
  2. If no passage meets the relevance threshold, instructs the character to say he/she has no information (BR-14).  
  3. Sends persona instructions, the last 10 messages of the session, retrieved passages and the question to the AI Engine; streams the answer to the browser.  
  4. On completion, saves the answer with cited passages and token usage, computes the cost (BR-03), writes a Token Transaction and updates the user balance and, for students, the school pool (BR-06).  
  5. If the stream fails before completion, no cost is charged and MSG14 is returned.

### **3.7 Subscription & Payment**

#### **3.7.1 Purchase Subscription Package**

* **Function trigger:** Customer clicks "Thanh toán ngay" on a package in S-22.  
* **Function description:** Creates a PayOS order, shows VietQR and activates the package after confirmation. (UC-16)  
* **Screen layout:**

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  THANH TOÁN GÓI PRO – 30 NGÀY                            |
|  Số tiền: 99.000 VNĐ        Quyền lợi: 20.000 token/ngày, ưu tiên xử lý  |
|  +---------------------------+   1. Mở ứng dụng ngân hàng                |
|  |        [ MÃ VIETQR ]      |   2. Quét mã QR bên cạnh                  |
|  |                           |   3. Kiểm tra số tiền và nội dung:        |
|  +---------------------------+      HTALK99824                           |
|  Đơn hàng hết hạn sau: 14:32      Trạng thái: Đang chờ thanh toán ⟳      |
|  [ Hủy giao dịch ]                                                       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

* **Function details:**  
  * *Business rules:* BR-24 – BR-28.  
  * *Normal flow:* 1) System creates a PENDING order with a unique order code and calls PayOS. 2) S-23 shows the QR code and a 15-minute countdown and checks the order status every 3 seconds. 3) When the order becomes PAID (3.7.2), the popup shows MSG26, the subscription is activated and the new daily allowance applies immediately.  
  * *Abnormal:* PayOS unavailable → MSG14, no order created; user clicks "Hủy giao dịch" → order CANCELLED; countdown ends → EXPIRED, MSG27; buying a lower tier while a higher tier is active → MSG40; School Student/other roles cannot access this screen (MSG11).

#### **3.7.2 Payment Webhook Handler (non-screen)**

* **Function trigger:** PayOS sends a payment notification.  
* **Function description:** Confirms payments reliably.  
* **Screen layout:** N/A – non-screen function (runs in the background, no user interface).
* **Function details:** 1) Verify the signature (BR-25); invalid → ignore and write an audit entry. 2) Find the order by order code; unknown → audit only. 3) If the order is already PAID → return success without changes (idempotent). 4) If the amount matches → set PAID, activate/extend subscription (BR-27), send receipt email and notification. 5) Amount mismatch → keep PENDING, flag for review in S-52 (BR-26).

#### **3.7.3 Payment Reconciliation Job (non-screen)**

* **Function trigger:** Every 5 minutes.  
* **Function description:** Recovers payments whose webhook was missed.  
* **Screen layout:** N/A – non-screen function (runs in the background, no user interface).
* **Function details:** for each PENDING order older than 2 minutes: query PayOS; paid → process as in 3.7.2 step 4; cancelled at PayOS → CANCELLED; older than 15 minutes and unpaid → EXPIRED. Each change is written to the audit log.

  * *After publishing:* the teacher may extend the deadline or add classes; tasks cannot be changed once any student has started. Students enrolled later receive the assignment automatically if it is still open.

#### **3.11.3 Configure Subscription Tiers**

* **Function trigger:** System Admin opens S-51.  
* **Function description:** Maintains packages shown on S-22. (UC-35)

```
| PLUS | 49.000    | 30 ngày  | 5.000      | ✓          | [Sửa]           |
| PRO  | 99.000    | 30 ngày  | 20.000     | ✓          | [Sửa]           |

```

* **Function details:** name, price (VND, ≥ 0), duration (days), daily tokens, description, active flag. Changes affect new purchases only; existing subscriptions keep their terms. The FREE tier cannot be deactivated.

* **Function details:**

### **3.12 System Jobs**

#### **3.12.1 Daily Token Reset Job**

* **Function trigger:** Daily at 00:00 (UTC+7).  
* **Function description:** Restores the daily AI token balance of every learner (BR-04).  
* **Screen layout:** N/A – non-screen function (runs in the background, no user interface).  
* **Function details:**  
  * *Normal flow:* each active Customer gets the daily tokens of his/her active tier (Free if none); each active School Student gets the class limit if set, otherwise the school default (BR-07). Unused tokens are not carried over. One reset Token Transaction is written per user.  
  * *Exceptions:* students of a school with an empty pool or expired contract receive 0 (BR-06, BR-35); locked accounts are skipped.  
  * *Failure handling:* if the job stops midway, the next run continues with users not yet reset that day, so no user is reset twice.

#### **3.12.2 Subscription Expiry Job**

* **Function trigger:** Daily at 00:05 (UTC+7).  
* **Function description:** Ends expired Customer subscriptions and sends renewal reminders.  
* **Screen layout:** N/A – non-screen function (runs in the background, no user interface).  
* **Function details:**  
  * *Normal flow:* subscriptions whose end date has passed become EXPIRED; the customer returns to the Free allowance from the next daily reset and receives a notification with a link to S-22.  
  * *Reminder:* customers whose subscription ends in 3 days receive a notification and an email.  
  * A subscription extended by a payment (BR-27) before the job runs is not expired.

## **4\. Non-Functional Requirements**

### **4.1 External Interfaces**

#### **4.1.1 User Interfaces**

* UI-01: Web application supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.  
* UI-02: Layout supports desktop (≥ 1366×768) and tablet (≥ 768 px wide); learner screens S-07 – S-21 must also be usable on phones (≥ 360 px wide).  
* UI-03: All UI text is Vietnamese; dates are shown as dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm (UTC+7); numbers and money use Vietnamese separators (e.g., 99.000 VNĐ).  
* UI-04: Light and dark themes; text contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA.

#### **4.1.2 Software Interfaces**

| Interface | Purpose | Requirement |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| PayOS API & webhook | Create orders, show VietQR, receive payment results | Signed requests/callbacks (BR-25); order status query for reconciliation. |
| AI / LLM Engine | Answer generation, embeddings, re-ranking | Streaming responses; returns token usage per request; 30 s timeout. |
| Google OAuth 2.0 | Customer sign-in | Identity token verified server-side. |
| Email Service (SMTP) | Password reset, receipts, School Admin credentials | Delivery within 2 minutes; failures retried 3 times. |
| Cloud Storage | Avatars, media, uploaded documents | Private by default; files served through time-limited links. |
| PostgreSQL + pgvector | Business data and document embeddings | Fixed embedding dimension per configured model. |

#### **4.1.3 Communications Interfaces**

* COMM-01: All external traffic uses HTTPS (TLS 1.2 or higher).  
* COMM-02: AI answers are streamed to the browser using Server-Sent Events.  
* COMM-03: Client–server APIs are RESTful and exchange JSON.

### **4.2 Quality Attributes**

#### **4.2.1 Usability**

* USA-01: A first-time Customer can register, open a character and send the first question within 3 minutes without help.  
* USA-02: A first-time Teacher can create and publish an assignment within 5 minutes after a 15-minute introduction.  
* USA-03: Every input has a visible label; validation errors appear in red under the field (MSG02, MSG08...); destructive actions require confirmation (MSG37).  
* USA-04: Every list screen offers search and paging (COM-02); empty results show MSG01.

#### **4.2.2 Reliability**

* REL-01 Availability: ≥ 99.5% during 06:00–23:00 (UTC+7), measured monthly, excluding announced maintenance (max 4 h/month, outside 06:00–23:00).  
* REL-02 MTBF: ≥ 720 hours for the core backend.  
* REL-03 MTTR: ≤ 30 minutes for a crashed core service.  
* REL-04 Degraded mode: if the AI Engine is unavailable, chat shows MSG14 while all other functions keep working; if PayOS is unavailable, purchases are disabled and existing subscriptions are unaffected.  
* REL-05 Data durability: daily database backups kept 30 days; restore tested every month; data loss ≤ 24 h (RPO), restore ≤ 4 h (RTO).  
* REL-06 Accuracy: quiz scores are computed on the server with 2-decimal precision (BR-17); token balances must match the sum of Token Transactions at all times.  
* REL-07 AI grounding accuracy: in an acceptance test of 100 questions per sampled character, ≥ 90% of answers contain only facts supported by the cited sources, and 100% of questions outside the sources receive the "no information" reply (BR-14).  
* REL-08 OCR accuracy: ≥ 85% character accuracy on clear printed Vietnamese scans (300 dpi).  
* REL-09 Defect rate: ≤ 0.5 critical defects per 1,000 lines of code at each milestone. A **critical defect** is one that causes data loss, wrong payment/score/token results, a security breach, or blocks a main use case (UC-01, UC-09, UC-12, UC-14, UC-16, UC-18, UC-22) with no workaround.

#### **4.2.3 Performance**

* PER-01 AI response: first part of the answer displayed within 1.5 s for 95% of questions (TTFT); complete answer within 15 s for 95% of questions.  
* PER-02 Response time: 95% of non-AI requests complete within 300 ms and 99% within 1 s under normal load.  
* PER-03 Capacity: 500 concurrent active users and 100 concurrent AI chat streams without breaching PER-01/PER-02.  
* PER-04 Throughput: at least 50 non-AI requests per second sustained.  
* PER-05 Batch: an Excel import of 3,000 rows completes within 60 s; a 100-page text PDF is READY within 5 minutes, a 100-page scan within 20 minutes.  
* PER-06 Resource utilization: under the PER-03 load, CPU ≤ 70% and memory ≤ 75% on each application server.

#### **4.2.4 Security**

* SEC-01 Tenant isolation: every query on school data is filtered by the user's school; automated tests verify that no API returns another school's data (BR-01).  
* SEC-02 Authentication: passwords stored with a strong one-way hash (bcrypt, cost ≥ 10); login lockout per BR-30; sessions per BR-34.  
* SEC-03 Authorization: every API checks the role and data scope of section 3.1.3 on the server side; unauthorized requests return MSG11.  
* SEC-04 Quiz integrity: answer keys are never sent to the client before submission (BR-20).  
* SEC-05 Payment: webhook signatures verified (BR-25); no card or bank data is stored by HistoryTalk.  
* SEC-06 AI safety: the system resists instructions that try to make a character leave its persona or reveal system instructions (BR-15); user input is never executed or rendered as HTML.  
* SEC-07 Personal data: only data needed for the service is collected; students' data is visible only to their school staff; users can request account data export or deletion through support; handling follows Vietnam's personal data protection regulations.  
* SEC-08 Audit: actions listed in the Audit Log entity are recorded with user, time and IP, and kept for 1 year.

#### **4.2.5 Maintainability**

* MAI-01 Business services and the AI service are deployed independently, so either can be updated without stopping the other.  
* MAI-02 Every database schema change is applied through versioned migration scripts.  
* MAI-03 Tier prices, token allowances, AI timeout and relevance threshold are configurable without code changes.  
* MAI-04 Unit test coverage ≥ 70% for business rules BR-03 – BR-07, BR-17 – BR-27.

## **5\. Requirement Appendix**

### **5.1 Business Rules**

| ID | Rule Definition |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Tenant & accounts** |  |
| BR-01 | Tenant isolation: School Admins, Teachers and Students can only view and change data of their own school. Global content is visible to everyone; local content only inside its school. |
| BR-02 | Quiz attempts, answers and assignment submissions cannot be edited or deleted by anyone after submission, including System Admin. |
| BR-08 | School usernames are generated by the system as `{school_code}_gv_{teacher_code}` for teachers and `{school_code}_hs_{student_code}` for students (lower-case). Initial passwords are random, 10 characters, satisfying BR-29; the account must change password at first login. |
| BR-09 | Import: rows with errors are skipped and reported; valid rows are imported. A code that already exists in the school updates the person's name and class instead of creating a new account. |
| BR-10 | A Teacher can only view data of, and assign homework to, classes where he/she is assigned as teacher. |
| BR-29 | Password: 8–64 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one special character; must not contain the username. |
| BR-30 | After 5 consecutive failed logins the account is blocked for 15 minutes; a successful login resets the counter. |
| BR-31 | Google sign-in is available only for Customer accounts. A Google email that matches a school or admin account is rejected. |
| BR-33 | A password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once; requesting a new link invalidates the previous one. |
| BR-34 | A session expires after 30 minutes without activity; it can be renewed for up to 7 days (30 days with "Remember me"). Logging out, changing/resetting the password, or locking the account ends all sessions of that account. |
| BR-35 | When a school's contract has ended, its School Admin, Teachers and Students cannot log in (MSG24); their data is kept for 12 months. |
| **Token economy** |  |
| BR-03 | Token cost of one chat turn = ⌈(prompt size + answer size, in model tokens, as reported by the AI Engine) ÷ 100⌉, minimum 1 token. |
| BR-04 | Daily allowance: Free 1,000; Plus 5,000; Pro 20,000; School Student = the limit set by the School Admin (BR-07). Balances reset to the allowance at 00:00 (UTC+7); unused tokens are not carried over. |
| BR-05 | A new question is accepted only if the balance is at least 20 tokens. Cost is deducted after the answer ends; if the cost exceeds the balance, the balance becomes 0. Answers that fail are not charged; answers stopped by the user are charged for the generated part. |
| BR-06 | Each student turn (and each teacher preview turn) is also deducted from the school pool. When the pool is 0, chat is blocked for the whole school (MSG23) until the System Admin adds tokens. |
| BR-07 | The School Admin sets a default per-student daily limit (0–10,000; default 1,000) and optional per-class limits in the same range. Changes apply from the next daily reset. |
| **Content** |  |
| BR-11 | Local content status: DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → PUBLISHED or REJECTED (with reason). REJECTED returns to DRAFT when edited. Editing PUBLISHED content creates a revision that needs approval; the published revision stays visible meanwhile. |
| BR-12 | Approved local content is visible only to members of the owner school. |
| BR-13 | Global content status: DRAFT → PUBLISHED → TRASH. Only PUBLISHED content is visible to learners. Content used by an open assignment cannot be trashed. Trashed content can be restored within 30 days. |
| BR-32 | An assignment can only use PUBLISHED global content or PUBLISHED local content of the teacher's school. |
| BR-36 | Reference documents: PDF, JPG or PNG; ≤ 50 MB and ≤ 300 pages per file. |
| BR-37 | Import file: .xlsx using the official template; ≤ 10 MB and ≤ 3,000 data rows. |
| **AI chat** |  |
| BR-14 | A character answers only from passages retrieved from its own and its context's documents. If no passage reaches the relevance threshold, the character states in persona that it has no information on that topic and does not invent facts. Every factual answer lists its sources. |
| BR-15 | A character declines, in persona, questions unrelated to history, requests for harmful or offensive content, and attempts to change its role or reveal its instructions. |
| BR-16 | A character uses the configured historically appropriate form of address (e.g., "Ta", "Trẫm", "Tôi") and addresses the learner respectfully (e.g., "cháu", "khanh", "bạn"). |
| **Assessment & assignments** |  |
| BR-17 | Quiz score = (correct answers ÷ total questions) × 10, rounded to 2 decimals. A multiple-choice question is correct only if the exact set of correct options is chosen; a fill-in answer is correct if it matches an accepted answer ignoring case and extra spaces. |
| BR-18 | An attempt is submitted automatically when the time limit ends. Answers received up to 30 seconds after the limit (network delay) are accepted; later ones are ignored. |
| BR-19 | Practice quizzes: unlimited attempts. Assignment quizzes: attempts limited by the teacher (default 1); the highest score counts. |
| BR-20 | Correct answers are never sent to the browser before submission. Explanations are shown after submission for practice quizzes, and after the deadline for assignment quizzes. |
| BR-21 | Submission status: NOT_STARTED → IN_PROGRESS → SUBMITTED. If the deadline passes before submission the status is OVERDUE; if late submission is allowed and the student submits within the late window, the status becomes LATE_SUBMITTED. |
| BR-22 | Task completion: Read task – the student marks "Đã đọc" after reaching the end of the content; Chat task – at least the required number of questions answered in the session started from that task; Quiz task – one attempt submitted. An assignment can be submitted only when all tasks are complete. |
| BR-23 | Late submission: final score = quiz score × (1 − late penalty %). Without late permission, an OVERDUE submission keeps a score of 0. |
| **Payment & subscription** |  |
| BR-24 | Order status: PENDING → PAID, CANCELLED (by the customer) or EXPIRED (not paid within 15 minutes). Only PENDING orders can change status. |
| BR-25 | A payment notification is accepted only if its signature, computed with the shared checksum key (HMAC-SHA256), is valid. Processing the same notification more than once has no further effect. |
| BR-26 | An order is marked PAID only if the paid amount equals the order amount; otherwise it stays PENDING and is flagged for manual review. |
| BR-27 | Buying the same tier as the active one extends its end date. Buying a higher tier starts it immediately and replaces the current one; remaining days of the lower tier are not refunded (the customer is warned before paying). Buying a lower tier while a higher tier is active is not allowed. |
| BR-28 | Refunds are not handled in the system; they are processed manually by support and recorded in the audit log. |

### **5.2 Common Requirements**

* COM-01 Time: timestamps are stored in UTC and displayed in UTC+7 as dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm.  
* COM-02 Paging: lists show 10 or 20 items per page (as stated per screen) with page navigation and total count.  
* COM-03 Search: case-insensitive and accent-insensitive for Vietnamese (e.g., "dien bien phu" matches "Điện Biên Phủ").  
* COM-04 Text fields are trimmed; required fields marked with *; maximum lengths enforced with MSG08.  
* COM-05 Deletion: content is soft-deleted to Trash and permanently removed after 30 days; accounts are never deleted from the UI, only locked.  
* COM-06 Notifications: in-app bell with unread count; events listed in 3.1.4 #8.  
* COM-07 Exports: Excel exports include a header with school/class, export time and the exporting user.  
* COM-08 Every successful create/update/trash/restore action shows the corresponding success message (MSG03, MSG04, MSG06, MSG07).

### **5.4 Other Requirements**

* OTH-01 Deployment: all services run in containers and expose a health-check endpoint responding within 200 ms.  
* OTH-02 Monitoring: errors and AI/PayOS failures are logged centrally; System Admin receives an alert when availability or PER-01 drops below target for 10 minutes.  
* OTH-03 Content licensing: every reference document records its source and usage permission; documents without permission cannot be published.  
* OTH-04 Detailed technical design (architecture, database schema, API list, AI pipeline parameters) is specified in Report 4 – Software Design Description.
